title: fix(plugin-email): a non-string recipient display name answers the send door's 400, not 500
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29891

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`POST /api/v1/email/send` 里 `to` / `cc` / `bcc` / `replyTo`（含列表项）的显示名不是字符串时，现在返回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`（"the display name of … must be a string"），不再是 500 `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED`；拒收记录照常写入 `sys_email`。
- **为什么改**：拒收判断本来就对（`formatCallerAddress`，#29250），但随后写拒收行的 `rawAddressText` 对调用方原始 `name` 调 `.trim()`，抛 TypeError，把 400 变成 500。
- **风险与回滚**：只改一个内部函数（未导出），非字符串显示名不写进拒收行（`error` 列已写明原因）；字符串、缺省、`null` 显示名行为不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` 的 `rawAddressText`；新 pin `packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`，预期 19 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/plugin-email` (patch).** `rawAddressText`, the writer of the rejection row in `EmailService.recordRejectedMessage`, reads each address part as unknown input: a string display name is trimmed and kept, any other type is left out of the row, and a non-object, non-string entry records nothing. It still judges nothing. `formatCallerAddress` stays the one place a caller's recipient shape is refused (it already refused non-string names, #29250), so no second validation was added.
- **`@objectstack/rest` (tests only, no changeset).** A new pin drives the real route (`HonoHttpServer` + `RestServer`) over the real `EmailServicePlugin` (log provider) with `sys_email` persistence wired, which is the stock showcase shape. `email-send-door-bounds.test.ts` uses a mail double and never reaches the writer. Supporting changes: a devDependency on `@objectstack/plugin-email` (lockfile importer row), an anchored source alias in `vitest.config.ts` (`check:test-source-alias`), the double's `update()` routed through `assertEngineUpdateDispatch`, and the regenerated `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` row (`check:engine-double-contract`).

### Same-pattern sweep (what I checked)

Every caller-supplied field the rejection row reads: `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `replyTo` and `from` all go through the one `rawAddressText`, so the fix covers all five. `subject` is `String(...)`; `text` / `html` are `typeof`-guarded; `address` is `String(...)`; `relatedObject` / `relatedId` / `sentBy` / `organizationId` are stored, not trimmed. On the validation side, `formatCallerAddress` covers all four recipient fields. `formatAddress` (the sender's path) still calls `obj.name?.trim()`, but the REST door replaces a caller `from` with the configured sender, so a caller's non-string sender name never reaches it through this route. Left as is.

## Why

Reproduced on `21510bba` (main) through the new pin before the fix: every non-string shape in every field answered `500` (see the ablation below). The card's own reproduction: `{"to":{"address":"ok@example.com","name":42},"subject":"x","text":"x"}`.

## Pins

`packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`, 19 cases:
- number / object / array / boolean display name × `to` / `cc` / `bcc` / `replyTo`: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with the exact message naming the field, one rejection row with `status: 'failed'`, `error: 'rejected before delivery: VALIDATION_FAILED: …'` and the bare address in the field's column (16);
- a `to` list entry with an object name: 400, and the row lists both entries (1);
- `null` name sends (200), and a string name sends (200) (2).

**Ablation, once.** Restored `const name = a.name?.trim()` in `rawAddressText` and rebuilt: 17 of 19 failed with `AssertionError: expected 500 to be 400` (all except the two 200 controls). Restored the fix: 19 passed.

**Deviation from the order (null).** The order listed `null` among the shapes that answer 400. `formatCallerAddress` deliberately treats `null` as "no name" (`name !== undefined && name !== null`), and `null?.trim()` never threw, so `null` already answered 200 before this PR. Making it 400 would refuse input the door accepts today (a narrowing), so `null` is pinned at 200 instead.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: exit 0.
- `typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck` for both packages: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Full `turbo run build --concurrency=2`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final head: 82 derived, 82 run, all exit 0; `--ran`: "82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". In the first round (before commit 2), `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:test-source-alias` were red and are fixed by commit 2. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 until the full build ran.
